title: The Uniform of Manchester's mill district
author: Freya Galloway
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
